rounds.text: New Swan Multitech Ltd is trading at a heavily discounted valuation, with a trailing P/E of just 8.15x [E1] and sitting only 12% of the way up its 52-week range [E4]. This valuation disconnect is further highlighted by a P/E of 8.73x and a P/B of 0.95x, which both trade at massive discounts to their respective sector benchmarks of 51.12x and 4.54x [E5, E6]. Operationally, the company is exceptional, generating a superior ROA of 14.27% compared to the sector's 5.19% and an extraordinary ROE of 39.9% against a sector benchmark of 14.73% [E7, E8]. Furthermore, discounted cash flow modeling places the intrinsic value at Rs 120 per share against a market price of Rs 42.8, creating a substantial margin of safety of 64.3% [E31, E32]. Conceded: the dividend yield is modest at 1.17% [E3]. Finally, a reverse DCF demonstrates that the current market price incorrectly prices in a -4.4% earnings growth, offering significant upside against the base case assumption of 10.0% growth [E33].

New Swan Multitech Ltd presents an exceptional valuation disconnect, trading at an extraordinarily modest P/E ratio of 8.15x [E1] and 8.73x against a sector benchmark of 51.12x [E5]. This pricing creates a massive margin of safety of 64.3%, with a discounted cash flow model indicating an intrinsic value of Rs 120 per share compared to a current market price of Rs 42.8 [E31, E32]. Furthermore, the company achieves elite profitability that vastly outperforms industry peers, delivering a remarkable return on equity of 39.9% versus a sector benchmark of 14.73% [E8] alongside a superior return on assets of 14.27% against the sector's 5.19% [E7]. Operational efficiency is underscored by a price-to-book ratio of just 0.95x compared to the sector benchmark of 4.54x [E6], while the reverse DCF indicates that today's price incorrectly assumes a negative earnings growth of -4.4% [E33]. Conceded: the stock currently languishes near the bottom of its yearly range, sitting only 12% of the way up its 52-week span [E4].
